# When to Use this Guide {#when-to-use-this-guide}

Use this guide to correct errors in your Experian Credit Report such as incorrect personal details, account information, or enquiries.

# Before You Get Started {#before-you-get-started}

Ensure you have the following information handy:

* ERN, an Experian Report Number, you can find it at the top right corner of your Experian Credit Report.   
* UTI, a globally unique identifier for your individual transactions. You can find it in the email body sent by Experian Credit View.

  ![][image1]

  **Note**: If ERN & UTI is older than 30 days, you will have to fetch a fresh report to raise a dispute.

  # Request a Correction in your Experian Credit Report {#request-a-correction-in-your-experian-credit-report}

  See the following procedure to raise a dispute or request a change in your personal details, financial information, and more.

  ## Access the Dispute Page {#access-the-dispute-page}


  Choose how to access the dispute page:


  **Note**: Prior to raising a dispute, if you have recently made any payments, then kindly wait for 30 days for any changes like foreclosures, payments, closures, and so on to reflect in your report.


  

1. Option A: Use this option if you have your ERN and UTI ready.  
   1. Navigate to the [dispute page link](https://consumer.experian.in/ECSINDIA-DCE/view/angular/index.html#!/).  
   2. On the Dispute form page, enter your Experian Reference Number (ERN), Unique Transaction ID (UTI), and then click Verify.  
   3. Jump to step 3\.

        
2. Option B: Use this option if you want to log in and manage disputes.  
1. Navigate to the [Dispute portal](https://consumer.experian.in/ECV-OLN/view/angular/#/).  
2. If you have an existing account, enter your mobile number and password. Or, click **Register Now\!** to create your account and follow the respective steps.  
3. Once you login, select **Dispute** \> **Raise new dispute**.  
4. Jump to step 3\.

   

   ![][image2]

   

3. After you login, select the relevant dispute type for which you want to request a change in information, including Account Details, Personal Details, and Credit Enquiry from the dropdown menu.

   	

   	![][image3]

   	

   	![][image4]

   	

4. Update incorrect fields, and then click **Submit**.

   

   **Note**: You can follow the same steps to correct information in your Personal and Loan Application Enquiry details.

   

   A pop-up with requested corrections & an option to add bank details as per RBI/2023-24/72 DoR.FIN.REC.48/20.16.003/2023-24 circular will be available.

   

   ![][image5]

   

5. Review and **Submit**.

   

   

   ### 	What next? {#what-next?}

   

* You will receive an acknowledgement email via email ID you provide  
* Your request is forwarded to the lender for verification  
* Updates may take up to 30 days  
* You can track status using “Track Disputes” at the header of the Dispute portal. 


  ![][image6]


  For any additional queries regarding your Experian Credit Score or Report, you can visit the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.experian.in/consumer/faq/) page.

  # Experian Support {#experian-support}

  If you need to raise a dispute related to your report (Consumer, Commercial or MFI), you can reach us through any of the following methods 

* Customer Support Helpline: 02268165681   
* Email: consumer.support@in.experian.com   
* Walk-in Address: Experian Credit Information Company of India Private Limited 5th Floor, East Wing, Tower 3, Equinox Business Park, LBS Marg, Kurla (West), 

  Mumbai \- 400 070, India

  # Disclaimer

* The data in the Experian Credit Report is based on the information reported by Banks and Financial Institutions and therefore, the concerned credit granting organizations own the data in your credit report.  
* Experian is not authorized to change the data in the credit report in any way without the written consent of the credit granting organization.  
* Experian only communicates with the credit granting organization on your behalf to correct errors in the credit report.  
* The final decision of updating the new values or information lies with your credit granting organization.  
* Post raising the dispute or sending the information to the consumer.support@in.experian.com, in case you have not received a response within 30 days, please write to principalnodalofficer.india@experian.com.
